title: Vegan Pantry Essentials: Staples, Substitutes, and Quick Prep Techniques
summary: Goodful host Rachel walks through a vegan pantry, listing staples across dried goods, canned goods, nuts and seeds, oils and condiments, spices, baking flours, soy protein substitutes, and produce. She offers practical notes and uses for each category, such as soaking dried chickpeas for hummus and falafel, lentils as a protein source, oat milk from oats, jackfruit as a canned meat substitute, and coconut milk for cooking or dairy-free creams. The tour also covers flavor builders (soy sauce, vegan mayo, vinegars, sauces), nut-based cheese options (cashews, tahini, nutritional yeast), and egg-replacement techniques (flax eggs, black salt with turmeric for tofu scramble). The video emphasizes waste reduction and bulk buying, plus storage tips like freezing produce to extend shelf life.

sections.title: Dried goods overview and legume staples
sections.description: Rachel lists core dried staples and notes chickpeas and lentils as particularly versatile for hummus, falafel, and vegan bolognese, with a nod to bulk buying.

sections.title: Grains and grain-based meals
sections.description: Discussion of whole grains and the idea of building grain bowls with protein, veggies, and dressings.

sections.title: Canned goods and meat substitutes
sections.description: Overview of canned items and how jackfruit resembles pulled meat; coconut milk for dairy-free recipes and desserts; beans and tomatoes as versatile bases; aquafaba noted as a dessert ingredient.

sections.title: Nuts, seeds, and nut butters
sections.description: Highlights on nuts and seeds as healthy fats and protein sources; cashews for dairy-like sauces, and the use of seeds and tahini in dressings and meals.

sections.title: Oils, condiments, and dressings
sections.description: Notes on using oils for cooking and baking, vinegars for dressings, and various sauces to diversify flavor.

sections.title: Spices, seasonings, and flavor boosters
sections.description: Emphasis on umami and savory depth from soy sauces and liquid smoke; bulilon as a lighter broth option; nutritional yeast and kala namak for cheesy and egg-like flavors; turmeric for color and health benefits.

sections.title: Baking essentials and egg substitutes
sections.description: Covers gluten for texture (seitan), gluten-free flour options, and plant-based egg replacers including flax eggs and egg-free baking considerations.

sections.title: Soy proteins and vegan dairy alternatives
sections.description: Introduction to soy-based proteins and dairy substitutes, with notes on preparing tofu and tempeh and trying vegan eggs, butter, and cheeses.

sections.title: Fruits, vegetables, and storage tips
sections.description: Encourages stocking fresh and frozen produce and freezing surplus to minimize waste and packaging.
